verdicts.reason: A shrinks the can to a tiny sliver jammed against the right edge: its SOLSTICE band can't be read, the product nearly disappears as a focal point, and the overlong one-line body copy runs almost into it. B keeps the can at a readable size with its label band and gives the copy a balanced two-line wrap, but a bokeh dot overlaps the can's edge. Both share the same flaws: about 170px of empty space left of the headline, a small CTA with tiny button text crammed near the bottom edge, and illegible fine print.
